findings.passage: His only released lead was the Australian series _Invisible Boys_.
findings.problem: Factual error in the hook's orientation, repeated in the ending ("As of September 2026, his released leads were _Invisible Boys_... and _We Were Liars_"). S15, which C38 and C85 cite, says "In 2023, he played the lead role of Dan in the crime documentary film The Speedway Murders". The film's Wikipedia page (opened 2026-09-13) bills Joseph Cumpston first, as Dan, gives an October 20, 2023 premiere, and says it was released in select Australian and American cinemas and on streaming on June 21, 2024. His own statement to Grace supports only a narrower claim: "I'd had small roles, but definitely not a lead role in a series." The editor introduced this sentence to satisfy unfamiliar-U03, so the orientation a new reader relies on is wrong.
findings.acceptance_test: The hook and the final paragraph either limit the claim to series leads (for example "his only released lead in a series"), consistent with his S03 statement, or name The Speedway Murders with its dates. A source for the film credit is added to the evidence record, and C85 and C38 are corrected to match. No other passage or FAQ implies he had no prior released lead.
